mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no, c.center_no, c.center_name, o.status_code, cc.code_name AS status_name, o.ordered_at, o.partner_contact_name, o.partner_contact_tel FROM wms.outbound_order o JOIN wms.center_info c ON c.center_info_id = o.center_info_id LEFT JOIN wms.code_group cg ON cg.group_code = 'OUT_STATUS' AND cg.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN wms.common_code cc ON cc.code_group_id = cg.code_group_id AND cc.code_value = o.status_code AND cc.is_active = TRUE WHERE o.order_no = #{order_no}

SELECT l.line_no, i.sku_no, i.item_name, l.order_qty, l.picked_qty FROM wms.outbound_order_line l JOIN wms.outbound_order o ON o.outbound_order_id = l.outbound_order_id JOIN wms.item_info i ON i.item_info_id = l.item_info_id WHERE o.order_no = #{order_no} ORDER BY l.line_no
SELECT c.center_info_id FROM wms.center_info c WHERE c.center_no = #{center_no} AND c.is_active = TRUE
SELECT i.item_info_id FROM wms.item_info i WHERE i.sku_no = #{sku_no} AND i.is_active = TRUE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX( CAST(substring(o.order_no FROM '[0-9]+$') AS INTEGER) ), 0) FROM wms.outbound_order o WHERE o.order_no ~ ('^OB-' || #{center_no} || '-[0-9]+$')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms.outbound_order ( order_no, center_info_id, status_code, ordered_at, created_by, updated_by, partner_contact_name, partner_contact_tel ) VALUES ( #{order_no}, #{center_info_id}, #{status_code}, now(), #{created_by}, #{updated_by}, #{partner_contact_name}, #{partner_contact_tel} )

INSERT INTO wms.outbound_order_line ( outbound_order_id, line_no, item_info_id, order_qty, picked_qty, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{outbound_order_id}, #{line_no}, #{item_info_id}, #{order_qty}, 0, #{created_by}, #{updated_by} )
